purpose.zh: 機油潤滑、散熱、帶走髒東西。用久了添加劑消耗、被燃燒產物稀釋，保護力下降；濾芯攔下來的雜質也要一起丟掉。
purpose.en: Oil lubricates, cools and carries dirt away. Over time the additives wear out and fuel and combustion by-products dilute it; the filter holding the debris goes too.

f30Method.zh: N20 的機濾在引擎上方，先換濾芯（讓濾座的油流回去），再拆底護板從車底放油。社群資料：機油約 4.5 L、濾芯蓋 25 Nm，加完用 iDrive 看油位（要熱車）。放油螺絲扭力依油底殼材質不同，待查證。BMW 用 CBS 依實際使用算剩餘里程，換完要歸零。
f30Method.en: The N20 filter is on top: change it first (so the housing drains back), then remove the undertray and drain from below. Community data: about 4.5 L of oil, filter cap 25 Nm; check the level in iDrive with the engine warm. Drain-plug torque depends on the sump material (unverified). BMW CBS calculates the remaining distance from actual use; reset it afterwards.

text.zh: CBS 依實際使用計算；參考表約 16,000 km（10,000 英里）或 12 個月，先到先換。
text.en: CBS calculates it from actual use; the reference table says about 16,000 km (10,000 miles) or 12 months, whichever first.

text.zh: 原廠間隔的一半：約 8,000 km 或 6 個月（嚴苛使用：塞車、短程、高溫）。
text.en: Half the factory interval: about 8,000 km or 6 months (severe use: traffic, short trips, heat).

name.zh: 機油濾芯（含 O 型環）

warnings.zh: 機油規格（BMW Longlife 認證等級）待查證，照車主手冊或原廠。
warnings.en: Oil approval (BMW Longlife grade) unverified; follow the owner manual or BMW.

purpose.zh: 擋住進到引擎的灰塵。塞住會讓引擎吸氣變難，渦輪車更明顯；破了則讓砂塵直接磨汽缸。
purpose.en: Stops dust entering the engine. A clogged one restricts breathing, noticeably on a turbo car; a torn one lets grit wear the cylinders.

f30Method.zh: 空濾盒在引擎室，鬆開上蓋就能換，不用工具或只要一般套筒。
f30Method.en: The airbox is in the engine bay; undo the lid and swap the element with no tools or a basic socket.

text.en: 320i: about 80,000 km (50,000 miles) or 60 months on the reference table.

text.zh: 每次換機油時檢查；灰塵多的環境約 16,000–24,000 km 就換。
text.en: Inspect at every oil change; in dusty conditions replace at about 16,000–24,000 km.

purpose.zh: 過濾進到車廂的空氣。台灣潮濕，濾網容易發霉，是車內霉味最常見的原因。
purpose.en: Filters the air entering the cabin. In a humid climate it grows mould and is the most common cause of a musty smell.

f30Method.zh: 在擋風玻璃下的進氣飾蓋底下，要先把雨刷設到維修位置（細節待查證）。CBS 有監控它。
f30Method.en: Under the cowl cover below the windscreen; put the wipers in the service position first (details unverified). CBS tracks it.

text.en: About 32,000 km (20,000 miles) or 24 months on the reference table.

text.zh: 沒有可靠數字來源：開冷氣有霉味、風量變小就換；梅雨季後檢查一次。
text.en: No reliable figure: replace when the A/C smells musty or airflow drops; check after the rainy season.

name.zh: 冷氣濾網（建議含活性碳）

purpose.zh: 電極會慢慢燒蝕、間隙變大，點火需要的電壓跟著變高，最後拖累考爾、造成失火。
purpose.en: The electrodes erode and the gap grows, so the coil needs more voltage until misfires start and the coils suffer.

f30Method.zh: 拆飾蓋、拆考爾就看得到。型號、間隙、扭力都待查證，照原廠資料。
f30Method.en: Remove the engine cover and coils to reach them. Plug type, gap and torque are unverified; use BMW data.

text.zh: 參考表約 96,000 km（60,000 英里）或 72 個月。較舊的資料寫 100,000 英里，以新版為準。
text.en: About 96,000 km (60,000 miles) or 72 months on the reference table. Older material says 100,000 miles; the newer table governs.
For this turbo direct-injection engine the community suggests about 48,000–64,000 km (30,000–40,000 miles).

purpose.zh: 考爾把 12 V 升到點火需要的高壓。壞掉時那一缸會失火、抖動，引擎燈閃。
purpose.en: The coil turns 12 V into ignition voltage. When it fails that cylinder misfires, the engine shakes and the warning light flashes.

f30Method.zh: 四顆考爾在氣門室蓋上方，一顆一根螺絲。懷疑哪一顆就和隔壁缸對調，看故障碼會不會跟著跑。
f30Method.en: The four coils sit on the valve cover, one bolt each. Swap a suspect coil with another cylinder and see whether the code follows it.

text.zh: BMW 保養參考表沒有這一項，沒有固定週期。
text.en: Not on the BMW service reference table; no fixed interval.

text.zh: 換火星塞時一起檢查；社群建議原廠車約 96,000–120,000 km（60,000–75,000 英里）預防性更換。
text.en: Inspect with every plug change; the community suggests preventive replacement at about 96,000–120,000 km (60,000–75,000 miles) on a stock car.

purpose.zh: 帶走引擎的熱，也防凍、防鏽。防鏽添加劑會隨時間消耗。
purpose.en: Carries heat away and protects against freezing and corrosion; the corrosion inhibitors deplete over time.

f30Method.zh: N20 是電子水泵，換冷卻液後要用診斷電腦跑排氣程序，或用抽真空加注工具。日常只要看副水箱液位。
f30Method.en: The N20 has an electric pump: after a coolant change the bleed routine must be run from a diagnostic tool, or use a vacuum filler. Day to day, just check the expansion tank.

text.zh: 原廠沒有固定更換週期（CBS 不監控冷卻液）。
text.en: No factory replacement interval (CBS does not monitor coolant).

text.zh: 嚴苛使用通則：約 3 年或 80,000 km（50,000 英里）。
text.en: Severe-use rule of thumb: about 3 years or 80,000 km (50,000 miles).

warnings.zh: 引擎熱的時候絕對不要開副水箱蓋。
warnings.en: Never open the expansion tank when the engine is hot.

purpose.zh: 煞車油會吸收空氣中的水分，沸點下降；重煞或下長坡時可能沸騰起泡，踏板變軟。所以它是「看時間」換，不是看里程。
purpose.en: Brake fluid absorbs moisture and its boiling point drops; under hard or long downhill braking it can boil and the pedal goes soft. That is why it is changed by time, not distance.

f30Method.zh: 從離總泵最遠的輪子開始排。油壺不能抽乾，否則空氣進到 ABS 要用診斷電腦排。
f30Method.en: Bleed from the wheel furthest from the master cylinder. Never let the reservoir run dry or air reaches the ABS unit and needs a diagnostic bleed.

text.zh: 第一次在 36 個月，之後每 24 個月（跟里程無關）。
text.en: First at 36 months, then every 24 months (distance does not matter).

text.zh: 同原廠：每 2 年；台灣潮濕，不要拖。
text.en: Same as factory: every 2 years; with Taiwan humidity, do not stretch it.

purpose.zh: 來令片是消耗品，磨到底會鐵磨鐵，碟盤也會跟著報廢。碟盤有最小厚度，刻在碟盤上。
purpose.en: Pads are consumables; worn to the backing plate they grind metal on metal and ruin the rotor. Rotors have a minimum thickness stamped on them.

f30Method.zh: BMW 用來令片磨損感知器加 CBS 估算剩餘里程。感知線被磨斷過就要換新。
f30Method.en: BMW uses pad wear sensors plus CBS to estimate the remaining distance. Replace a sensor once its wire has been worn through.

text.zh: 沒有固定週期：依磨損感知器與 CBS 顯示。
text.en: No fixed interval: follow the wear sensors and CBS display.

text.zh: 沒有可靠數字來源：每次換機油時目視檢查厚度；換來令片時量碟盤厚度。
text.en: No reliable figure: check pad thickness at every oil change and measure the rotors when changing pads.

purpose.zh: 自排油同時是潤滑油、冷卻液和液壓油：離合器靠它結合、閥體靠它控制。油老化會讓換檔變慢、變頓。
purpose.en: ATF is lubricant, coolant and hydraulic fluid at once: it engages the clutches and runs the valve body. Aged fluid makes shifts slow and harsh.

f30Method.zh: 8HP 的濾網和油底殼一體，換油要換整個油底殼。油位要在油溫約 40–50 °C、引擎運轉時補到加油孔溢出。
f30Method.en: On the 8HP the filter is part of the pan, so the pan is replaced. Set the level with the engine running at about 40–50 °C, filling until it spills from the fill hole.

text.zh: BMW 標示為「終身」免換（測試到約 100,000 英里）。
text.en: BMW calls it "lifetime" (tested to about 100,000 miles).

text.zh: ZF 自己的建議：8 年或 80,000 km；高溫塞車可以提早。
text.en: ZF's own recommendation: 8 years or 80,000 km; earlier in heat and traffic.

warnings.zh: 先確認加油孔打得開才放油。
warnings.en: Make sure the fill plug opens before draining.

purpose.zh: 潤滑齒輪、軸承和同步器。同步器靠油的摩擦特性工作，用錯油會換檔卡卡的。
purpose.en: Lubricates the gears, bearings and synchronisers. The synchros depend on the oil's friction properties, so the wrong oil makes shifting notchy.

f30Method.zh: GS6-17BG 用 MTF LT-3（料號 83222339221，零件型錄資料）。換油週期與用量待查證。
f30Method.en: The GS6-17BG uses MTF LT-3 (part number 83222339221, per the parts catalogue). Interval and capacity unverified.

text.zh: 原廠週期待查證。
text.en: Factory interval unverified.

text.zh: 沒有可靠數字來源：換檔變卡、有異音時先換油再判斷。
text.en: No reliable figure: if shifts get notchy or noisy, change the oil before diagnosing further.

warnings.zh: 先鬆加油孔，確定打得開再放油。
warnings.en: Undo the fill plug first, then the drain.

purpose.zh: 差速器裡是斜齒輪，齒面壓力很大，靠齒輪油保護。油老化後齒面磨損、會有嗚嗚聲。
purpose.en: The differential uses hypoid gears under very high tooth pressure, protected by gear oil. Aged oil lets the teeth wear and whine.

f30Method.zh: 後差速器在車尾中間，加油孔和放油孔都在殼上。油規格與用量待查證。
f30Method.en: The rear differential is in the middle at the back; fill and drain plugs are on the casing. Oil specification and capacity unverified.

text.zh: BMW 保養參考表沒有這一項，沒有固定週期。
text.en: Not on the BMW service reference table; no fixed interval.

text.zh: 社群建議約 80,000 km（50,000 英里）換一次；這是 BMW 通則，非 F30 專屬。
text.en: The community suggests about 80,000 km (50,000 miles); a general BMW rule, not F30-specific.

purpose.zh: 帶動發電機和冷氣壓縮機（N20 的水泵是電子的，不靠皮帶）。皮帶斷了會沒有發電、沒有冷氣。
purpose.en: Drives the alternator and A/C compressor (the N20 water pump is electric, not belt-driven). If it snaps you lose charging and A/C.

f30Method.zh: 張緊器用扳手轉開就能取下。漏油（例如機濾座墊片）滴到皮帶會讓它提早壞。
f30Method.en: Turn the tensioner with a wrench to release it. Oil leaks (e.g. the oil-filter-housing gasket) dripping on the belt kill it early.

text.zh: BMW 保養參考表沒有這一項，沒有固定週期。
text.en: Not on the BMW service reference table; no fixed interval.

text.zh: 沒有可靠數字來源：每次保養看有沒有裂紋、掉屑、沾油、尖叫聲。
text.en: No reliable figure: at every service look for cracks, shedding, oil and squeal.

purpose.zh: 起動引擎、熄火時供電。高溫會加速電瓶老化。
purpose.en: Starts the engine and powers the car when it is off. Heat ages a battery faster.

f30Method.zh: 電瓶在行李廂右側地板下，負極線上有 IBS（智慧電瓶感知器）。IBS 會依電瓶老化調整發電機的充電方式；換新電瓶後要用診斷電腦「註冊」，把充電表重設。沒註冊會用舊電瓶的高充電率，新電瓶壽命變短、油耗變差、皮帶與發電機也較快磨損。換不同容量或類型還要另外設定（細節待查證）。
f30Method.en: The battery sits under the boot floor on the right, with the IBS (intelligent battery sensor) on the negative lead. The IBS adapts charging as the battery ages; after fitting a new battery it must be "registered" with a diagnostic tool to reset that table. Unregistered, the car keeps charging at the old battery's higher rate: shorter life, worse economy, extra wear on the belt and alternator. A different capacity or type also needs coding (details unverified).

text.zh: 沒有固定週期；換電瓶後一定要註冊。
text.en: No fixed interval; a new battery must be registered.

text.zh: 沒有可靠數字來源：高溫縮短壽命，每次保養用診斷電腦看電瓶健康度。
text.en: No reliable figure: heat shortens life; check battery health with a diagnostic tool at every service.

name.zh: 同規格電瓶（AGM 或原車類型）
name.en: Battery of the same type (AGM or as fitted)

warnings.zh: 拆：先負極後正極；裝：先正極後負極。
warnings.en: Off: negative first. On: positive first.

purpose.zh: 刷片橡膠被日曬、高溫、臭氧弄硬，刷不乾淨就危險。
purpose.en: Sun, heat and ozone harden the rubber, and a blade that streaks is a safety issue.

f30Method.zh: 先把雨刷設到維修位置才能立起來；左右尺寸可能不同。
f30Method.en: Use the service position before lifting the arms; left and right sizes can differ.

text.zh: BMW 保養參考表沒有這一項，沒有固定週期。
text.en: Not on the BMW service reference table; no fixed interval.

text.zh: 6–12 個月；台灣日曬強，偏向 6 個月，刷出水痕就換。
text.en: 6–12 months; with strong sun lean towards 6, and replace as soon as it streaks.

purpose.zh: 前後輪磨耗不同，定期換位讓四條胎磨得平均。胎壓不足會吃胎、耗油、高速發熱。
purpose.en: Front and rear tyres wear differently; rotating evens it out. Low pressure wears tyres, wastes fuel and overheats them at speed.

f30Method.zh: 前後尺寸相同才能前後換；前後不同（staggered）只能左右換。胎壓照駕駛側門框標籤、冷胎時量，調完在 iDrive 重設胎壓監測。
f30Method.en: Front-to-rear only if all four sizes match; with staggered sizes only side to side. Set pressures cold to the driver door-jamb label, then reset the tyre monitor in iDrive.

text.zh: BMW 保養參考表沒有這一項，沒有固定週期。
text.en: Not on the BMW service reference table; no fixed interval.

text.zh: 輪胎廠建議每 5,000–7,500 英里（約 8,000–12,000 km）換位；胎壓每月冷胎量一次。
text.en: The tyre maker suggests rotating every 5,000–7,500 miles (about 8,000–12,000 km); check pressures cold monthly.

warnings.zh: 輪圈螺絲扭力待查證，一定要用扭力扳手、對角鎖。
warnings.en: Wheel bolt torque unverified; always use a torque wrench in a star pattern.
